rootCause: Konva circle gradients are local to the shape, but the adapter supplied the SVG circle's absolute center as the local gradient center.
clippingMechanism: The radial gradient center was shifted upward by 70 design units, so the lower half fell outside the gradient before reaching the flange.

glowDrawOrder.text: const glow = lit ? `<circle data-layer="glow" cx="${LED_SPEC.GLOW_CX}" cy="${LED_SPEC.GLOW_CY}" r="${LED_SPEC.GLOW_RADIUS}" fill="url(#${prefix}-glow)" pointer-events="none"/>` : "";

viewBox.text: return `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" id="${prefix}-root" viewBox="-120 -180 240 220" data-part-type="led" data-color="${color}" data-lit="${lit}" data-burnt="${burnt}" data-theme="${theme}" data-pitch="${PITCH}" data-anchor-spacing="${ANCHOR_SPACING}"><defs>${defs}</defs>${labelStyle}${glow}<g data-layer="legs" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"><path data-layer="leg-anode" d="${legAPath}" stroke="${LED_SPEC.LEG_COLOR}" stroke-width="${LED_SPEC.LEG_WIDTH}"/><path data-layer="leg-anode-edge" d="${legAPath}" stroke="${LED_SPEC.LEG_EDGE_COLOR}" stroke-width="${LED_SPEC.LEG_EDGE_WIDTH}"/><path data-layer="leg-cathode" d="${legKPath}" stroke="${LED_SPEC.LEG_COLOR}" stroke-width="${LED_SPEC.LEG_WIDTH}"/><path data-layer="leg-cathode-edge" d="${legKPath}" stroke="${LED_SPEC.LEG_EDGE_COLOR}" stroke-width="${LED_SPEC.LEG_EDGE_WIDTH}"/></g><path data-layer="flange" d="${flangePath}" fill="${palette.flange}" stroke="${palette.rim}" stroke-width="${LED_SPEC.OUTLINE_WIDTH}"/><g data-layer="body"><path d="${bodyPath}" fill="url(#${prefix}-body)"/>${cup}</g>${core}${highlight}${ring}<path data-layer="outline" d="${bodyPath}" fill="none" stroke="${palette.rim}" stroke-width="${LED_SPEC.OUTLINE_WIDTH}" stroke-opacity="${LED_SPEC.OUTLINE_OPACITY}" pointer-events="none"/>${selection}<g data-layer="anchors"><circle data-anchor="anode" cx="${ANCHOR_A_X}" cy="${ANCHOR_Y}" r="3.2" fill="${palette.pin}" stroke="${palette.surface}" stroke-width="1.5"/><circle data-anchor="cathode" cx="${ANCHOR_K_X}" cy="${ANCHOR_Y}" r="3.2" fill="${palette.pin}" stroke="${palette.surface}" stroke-width="1.5"/></g>${labels}<g data-layer="hit-areas" fill="transparent" pointer-events="all"><rect data-hit="body" x="-52" y="-120" width="104" height="128"/><circle data-hit="anode" cx="${ANCHOR_A_X}" cy="${ANCHOR_Y}" r="8"/><circle data-hit="cathode" cx="${ANCHOR_K_X}" cy="${ANCHOR_Y}" r="8"/></g></svg>`;
